name: Anador
source:
Lucas, a 20-year-old, is transported to a fantasy world after being hit by a bus. There, he meets a strong and arrogant dark elf named Lyra and is invited to visit her village. In the village, he discovers that Lyra is actually the tribe's princess and finds himself embroiled in a conflict between her people and other elves. As he explores this magical and unknown world, Lucas faces challenges and surprising discoveries, including the fact that he is the only man in the village. With the help of Lyra and other characters, he embarks on a journey to find his true identity and his way back home.

[From [url=https://npcz.itch.io/anador]Itch.io[/url]]
